name: corner-shop-break
style: Instrumental big beat heist groove, 108 BPM, loud compressed dusty funk drum break with a lazy swing, round fuzzy bassline, low smoky organ stabs, short vinyl scratch accents on the turnarounds, low tense string ostinato underneath. Lean and dry, the midrange left open for a narrator, small shaker and a bright little bell ping as the hook. Midway the record slows to a turntable stop and the groove dies to silence; a glockenspiel climbs a major arpeggio like coins dropping into a jar, then the break slams back in warmer and hopeful, ending on one tight stop hit.
exclude: vocals, singing, choir, rap, vocal chops, spoken word samples, EDM drop, dubstep wobble, trap hi-hats, guitar solo, long fade out
